unresolved_intent.decision: Higher numeric priority value executed before lower values
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec specifies 'HIGHEST priority' without numeric direction; ascending numeric convention implies higher numbers = higher priority

unresolved_intent.decision: Duplicate entries in needs array treated as single dependency via set semantics
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec does not address duplicate dependency entries; set representation is mathematically correct for directed acyclic graphs

unresolved_intent.decision: Extra fields in job objects and root object ignored; only required schema validated
unresolved_intent.rationale: JSON is extensible by design; spec defines required structure but does not forbid additional properties

unresolved_intent.decision: Input array index preserved for stable FIFO tie-breaking on equal priority
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec requires deterministic scheduling 'appears FIRST in input array'; index tracking ensures scheduling is stable across multiple runs

unresolved_intent.decision: Any validation error (duplicate id, unknown dependency, cycle, malformed) rejects entire input; never emit partial schedule
unresolved_intent.rationale: Spec mandates 'print exactly ERROR' and 'never a partial schedule' on structural errors; eager validation enforces this contract
